compiled_state.title: Create plugins/dso/scripts/audit-closure-checks-migration.sh to scan tickets lacking Closure Checks section
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: RED -> GREEN

## What to build
Create plugins/dso/scripts/audit-closure-checks-migration.sh so the RED test from T1 passes.

## Script requirements (from DD1 + DD2)

### Location and permissions
- File: plugins/dso/scripts/audit-closure-checks-migration.sh
- Must be executable: chmod +x immediately after creation (CLAUDE.md rule 11)

### Behavior
Scan all ticket directories in TRACKER_DIR and output a tab-separated line for each epic or story that lacks a "## Closure Checks" section in its description.

### Exit codes
- 0 — found tickets to migrate (at least one ticket lacks the section)
- 1 — all tickets already migrated (every epic/story has the section)
- 2 — error (tracker dir not found, unreadable, etc.)

### Output format (DD2)
One tab-separated line per ticket needing migration:
  <ticket-id>TAB<type>TAB<status>TAB<title>
- Only include tickets of type epic or story
- Only scan tickets whose status is NOT closed or deleted
- If a ticket has SNAPSHOT event, prefer compiled_state for type/status/title/description
- Otherwise derive from CREATE + latest EDIT events

### Implementation approach: single-pass python3 inline
Use a single python3 heredoc invocation (same pattern as ticket-migrate-brainstorm-tags.sh) to:
1. Walk TRACKER_DIR dirs (skip hidden dirs, skip non-dirs)
2. For each ticket dir: read all .json event files in sorted order, reconstruct type/status/title/description
3. If type is epic or story AND description does not contain "## Closure Checks" — emit TSV line to stdout
4. Track found_count and emit correct exit code

### Error handling
- If TRACKER_DIR does not exist: print error to stderr, exit 2
- If tracker is empty (no ticket dirs): exit 1 (all migrated)
- Handle JSON decode errors gracefully (skip malformed event files)

## Prior art
See plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-migrate-brainstorm-tags.sh for the single-pass python3 inline pattern.

## Verify
Run: bash tests/scripts/test-audit-closure-checks-migration.sh
Expected: all assertions pass (GREEN)

DEPENDS_ON: T1 (RED test must exist first)
